title: spec: retire the inline-row decline in `page-component-filter-record-to-rule-array` once the objectui pin carries objectui#10767
body:
Restart-when: `.objectui-sha` on `main` names an objectui commit that contains `17b323e5ca` (objectui#10767's merge)
Restart-touch: .objectui-sha

**What.** The D2 conversion `page-component-filter-record-to-rule-array` (`packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`, `rendersInlineRows`) declines to rewrite a filter on a component whose rows are inline: `data` with provider `value`, or `staticData`. The reason is that the objectui renderer at the pinned `.objectui-sha` (`f8a9d0fb05`) matches such rows in memory with a matcher that does not read the rule-array form. The conversion therefore leaves the stored filter as it is and reports it as a TODO row (#17321's channel, PR #20244), worded as a limit of the pinned renderer.

**Why it can retire.** objectui#10767, merged upstream as `17b323e5ca`, teaches that in-memory matcher the rule-array form. Once `.objectui-sha` carries it, the decline protects nothing. It then only leaves convertible filters unconverted and reports TODOs that no longer need to exist.

**Work, on restart:**
- Re-measure first. Confirm that the pinned objectui's inline-row matcher reads the rule array, with a lit control.
- Then remove the `rendersInlineRows` decline from the conversion, together with the inline-row sentence of its two D3 entries (`18.element-data-source-and-object-block-filter-rule-array.ts` and `18.object-grid-default-filters-rule-array.ts`), and the corresponding pins.
- Regenerate the registry.
- If the conversion's released behaviour changes, grade the ADR-0087 disposition.

**Origin.** Named by the dev report on #17321 (`5856538210`, out-of-scope finding 3), carried as the PM's follow-up in #17321's ACCEPT. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 4 (`session_01CiCTczDo7tGhafXjf61dUJ`) as a derived card of in-flight #17321, so it carries `domain:spec`. It is held on the pin, which is the only thing that wakes it.

Dedupe words: `rendersInlineRows decline retire` · `inline rows rule array matcher objectui pin` · `objectui#10767 pin bump conversion decline`
